authority: CEO Round 153: 'Every candidate must be simultaneously attacked by science, prior art, physiology, competitor capability, design-around analysis and buyer integration analysis. Competitors are both adversaries and potential customers.'

VIEshunt.current_stage: Acute ovine study complete. Next-gen prototype for pre-clinical studies in development.
capabilities: IMU (inertial measurement unit) for posture detection
what_VIEshunt_CANNOT_do: Predict failure before it happens (latent degradation)
Track longitudinal response-manifold deviation from patient-specific baseline
Classify failure mode (obstruction vs overdrainage vs fracture vs migration) from response dynamics
Learn patient-specific degradation trajectory over months/years
Provide early warning with clinically meaningful lead time
VIEshunt.c2_Y_overlap: HIGH — VIEshunt already does perturbation response + posture adaptation + intelligent control
VIEshunt.c2_Y_advantage: C2-Y must demonstrate LATENT DEGRADATION PREDICTION that VIEshunt's control-oriented approach cannot achieve. The distinction: VIEshunt controls current state; C2-Y predicts future failure from response-manifold deviation.
VIEshunt.design_around_risk: HIGH — if VIEshunt adds longitudinal tracking and failure prediction, C2-Y's moat collapses
VIEshunt.acquisition_fit: MEDIUM — VIEshunt is academic, not commercial. A validated failure-prediction layer could be licensed to whichever company commercializes VIEshunt-like technology.

CereVasc_eShunt.current_stage: STRIDE pivotal trial fully enrolled (32 sites). $85M Series C (J&J Innovation, Medtronic participating). PMA pathway.
capabilities: Endovascular transdural CSF diversion (IPS to CPA cistern)
Passive drainage (no pump/sensor in current version)
CereVasc_eShunt.c1_overlap: DIRECT — C1 (passive rescue) is designed for the eShunt platform
CereVasc_eShunt.c2_Y_overlap: INDIRECT — C2-Y could be a future eShunt enhancement
CereVasc_eShunt.acquisition_fit: VERY HIGH — CereVasc is the primary platform. Any intelligence layer (C1-X, C2-Y) that integrates with eShunt anatomy is more valuable to CereVasc than as a standalone product.
CereVasc_eShunt.design_around_risk: LOW for platform-specific inventions (eShunt anatomy is unique). HIGH for generic shunt intelligence (VIEshunt-like competitors could implement similar intelligence on different hardware).

Nature_2026_ICP_monitor.current_stage: First-in-human safety study (20 patients, adults and children)
known_limitations: Monitors pressure only — no flow, no intelligence, no prediction
Nature_2026_ICP_monitor.strategic_implication: Makes 'invent another pressure sensor' a weak strategy. The moat must be in INFERENCE and PREDICTION, not sensing hardware. This sensor could be an INPUT to C2-Y's response-manifold model — making the sensor company a potential partner/customer.

Sophysa.product: Adjustable and anti-siphon hydrocephalus valves (Sophy Mini SM8, etc.)
Sophysa.acquisition_fit: MEDIUM — Sophysa could integrate an intelligence layer into their valve platform

Medtronic_Integra.products: Medtronic: SynchroMed pump, Strata valve. Integra: Codman valves, neurocritical care monitoring
Medtronic_Integra.acquisition_fit: HIGH — both have hydrocephalus + CNS delivery portfolios. C1-X/C2-Y intelligence layer or C3-X delivery platform could integrate with their existing products.

Biogen_Alcyone.c3_overlap: DIRECT — ThecaFlex is a competing CNS delivery platform
Biogen_Alcyone.c3_advantage: C3 could potentially offer: closed-loop dosing, physiology-aware delivery, continuous monitoring + adaptive delivery. ThecaFlex is open-loop.
Biogen_Alcyone.acquisition_fit: HIGH — Biogen paid $85M for Alcyone. A closed-loop CNS delivery layer (C3-X) could be worth more to Biogen than as a standalone product.
Biogen_Alcyone.design_around_risk: MEDIUM — ThecaFlex already provides intrathecal access. C3's advantage must be in the INTELLIGENCE layer, not the access hardware.

thrombosis_digital_twins.products: Academic research on digital twins for thrombosis/stroke risk
known_limitations: No validated mechanistic precursor for fragmentation
thrombosis_digital_twins.c5_X_overlap: HIGH — the field is moving toward exactly what C5-X proposes
thrombosis_digital_twins.c5_X_advantage: C5-X must demonstrate: validated precursor (survives actual clotFoam), independent physics (multi-world), patient-specific twin, intervention optimization. Generic 'AI + clot' is NOT enough.
thrombosis_digital_twins.design_around_risk: HIGH — multiple academic groups are pursuing similar directions. C5-X's moat must be in VALIDATED MECHANISTIC PRECURSOR, not in the concept of digital twins.

c2_y_reclassification.new_name: C2-Y: Longitudinal Shunt Response-Manifold Failure Prediction
c2_y_reclassification.rationale: Per CEO: perturbation testing is PRIOR_ART_KNOWN (VIEshunt, PMID 26208258, 27203135). The potential novelty is not perturbation itself but LONGITUDINAL LATENT-DEGRADATION PREDICTION from response-manifold deviation.
c2_y_reclassification.prior_art_status: PERTURBATION_TESTING = PRIOR_ART_KNOWN. LATENT_DEGRADATION_PREDICTION = POTENTIALLY_NOVEL (no system demonstrates this).
what_must_be_proven: Response-manifold deviation detects degradation BEFORE static pressure threshold (lead-time advantage)
Response signature distinguishes failure modes better than existing monitoring
Result survives model uncertainty and sensor drift
VIEshunt-like systems CANNOT achieve this with their current control-oriented approach

conditions: SCIENTIFICALLY_VALIDATED (mechanism survives adversarial virtual worlds + independent reproduction + VVUQ)
PRIOR_ART_SURVIVES (claim-level §102/§103 analysis complete, strongest combination survived)
COMPETITIVE_MOAT_CONFIRMED (design-around risk acceptable, competitor cannot easily replicate)
BUYER_FIT_CONFIRMED (at least one identified acquirer/partner for whom this plugs into existing product)
updated_world_class_gate.rationale: An invention may be scientifically brilliant but commercially weak. Or it may be novel but easily designed around. Both are excluded from the portfolio.

components.COMPETITIVE_GAP: What competitors cannot currently do × how long that gap will last
components.MOAT_VALUE: Strategic value to identified acquirers × difficulty to design around

updated_acquisition_formula.rule: Preserve separate components so commercial score can never manufacture scientific confidence.
